name: New Guomai Digital Culture Co., Ltd.
summary: New Guomai Digital Culture Co., Ltd. engages in digital content, digital intelligence applications, points redemption, and other internet-related businesses in China. The company operates in four segments: Internet and Related Services; Business Services; Accommodation Business; and Other Businesses. It is involved in the collection, production, broadcasting, and viewing of digital content; digital intelligence; and travel and exhibitions, as well as provides intelligent services and e-sports rooms.
